description: Latest mark price, oracle price and current hourly funding rate of one Hyperliquid perp, with the time of the reading. The funding rate is a fraction per hour (0.0000125 = 0.00125%); positive means longs pay shorts. Use it when you need the oracle price or funding next to the mark, for example for basis or premium. For only the price use get_price, for funding history get_funding_rates, and for many markets at once get_markets_snapshot.

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

name: get_mark_prices

base_market.description: Display symbol without the HIP-3 issuer prefix

issuer.description: HIP-3 builder code ("" for native markets)

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page; null on the last page

title: Mark and oracle price
